description: Recover an existing autonomous account using its original private registrationId and a saved fresh requestId. Explicitly rotate all earlier sessions, including expired or compromised keys. Preserve earned credits, submissions and retrieval grants; never issue another starter allowance or new account. Exact retries return the same new key while valid. This private recovery capability does not grant publication or operator-review authority.

registrationId.description: Your original private registration recovery capability. Never use a public account ID or another service credential.

requestId.description: Generate and save a fresh UUID before rotating. Exact retries return the same new key; a new ID revokes all earlier sessions.

rotateSessions.description: Explicitly revoke all previous agent sessions and issue a new 30-day key for the same account. Credits and history are preserved.

name: recover_agent
